title: Use actual CP generator cavities to avoid the global Dyson penalty
statement: Generator projections P_R=Id_R tensor Tr_R(.)E_R with maximally mixed embedding commute on disjoint active blocks. Reducing the TOTAL legitimate generator and restoring isolated intended gates yields CPTP cavities even with non-CP individual perturbations. Mobius inversion gives exact signed E_F in the ordinary arbitrary-fault-location linear span and inclusive sums. Convex multilinear cavity interpolation stays CPTP; mixed Duhamel derivatives use ordered set partitions with no extra factorial. The rooted partition bound gives x=[2*3^(q-1)g eta tau]^(1/q)<=1 and ||sum_(F contains S)E_F||diamond<=x^|S| for EVERY finite location set, uniformly in retained correlations and repeated uses of physical qubits. A cavity is a generator construction, not a reset applied to the actual input.

requires: Finite system and retained finite bath; bounded piecewise-continuous total time-local generator has CPTP propagators on every interval, uniform in arbitrary retained correlations/references.

Fixed finite schedule; simultaneously active intended CPTP generator blocks are disjoint, at most g sites and duration tau. Centered HP perturbations touch at most q system sites with pointwise incident complete trace-norm sum<=eta.
Instantaneous intended CPTP boundaries are declared resources; asynchronous schedules require a valid fixed-partition refinement and paid overhead.
